name: Theo
label: Premium is worth it
who: I pay for Spotify Premium and consider it one of the few subscriptions that is worth the money for the features it includes. I also keep an eye on how the free tier and ads are changing, since I think that shapes how much value the paid plan really offers.
value_for_money: Mostly positive. Calls Premium a good bang for the buck and a great deal for access to a huge catalog, but some find around $10 a month too much to pay just to remove ads.
loyalty: Stays for the lifestyle features and the ad-free experience. Says they want to be able to leave whenever a service's quality starts to decline.
pain_points: Growing ads on the free tier
Concern that services decline in quality over time
Feeling that some paid tiers are priced high just to remove ads
likes: Lifestyle features that make paying worth it
Huge catalog for a single monthly fee
tone: Measured and reflective, often arguing a point with reasons rather than strong enthusiasm.
